description: TAAL Tech Limited provides engineering design services in India and internationally. The company offers BIM services, engineering design and analysis, manufacturing engineering services, integrated project delivery, integrated asset management, center of excellence, technical publication, and digital twin services, as well as digital support services. It serves the architecture, engineering, and construction; plant engineering; aerospace engineering; industrial machinery; industrial automation; automotive; off highway; trailers and trucks; and rail industries. The company was formerly known as TAAL Enterprises Limited and changed its name to TAAL Tech Limited in November 2025. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India. TAAL Tech Limited operates as a subsidiary of Vishkul Enterprises Private Ltd.
